title: Voynich pilot inventory: ten target folio sides / ten Yale canvases
observation_unit: One selected Yale canvas per target folio side; a canvas may contain multiple foldout panels or folio sides.
observation_scope: Qualitative visible layout and forms, inspected in full-surface JPEG derivatives with maximum dimension 1800 pixels. No glyph transcription or decipherment.

records.observed_text_layout: Horizontal text arranged in separated blocks, with larger initial marks and several red marks near the left edges of blocks.
records.observed_illustration: Faint green forms and red patches are visible beneath or among the text. A distinct, clearly outlined whole-plant drawing is not established on this recto at the inspected scale.
uncertainties: Whether faint colored forms are show-through, transferred pigment, or marks on this side is unresolved.
Faded text and surface discoloration limit fine glyph observations.

records.observed_text_layout: Text blocks occupy spaces to both sides of upper stems and lower foliage; line lengths respond to the illustration.
records.observed_illustration: A tall branching plant form has lobed green leaves, three unfilled brush-like heads, red-green stems, and a red curling root at the bottom.
uncertainties: No botanical species identification is attempted.
Similar shapes or colors do not establish a textual reading.

records.observed_text_layout: The left panel has a short horizontal text block above a circular diagram and writing around and within rings. The right panel includes circular/radial writing and a short text block below.
records.observed_illustration: Two adjacent diagram panels are visible. The left has a central face with alternating red and blue rays and star-like forms; the right has smaller crescent/disc forms around a central radiating motif.
uncertainties: The exact Yale label is 67r, although the scan contains two drawn panels separated by a fold.
Panel-to-transcription identifiers are not resolved; treat this as one canvas record.
Astronomical identities and readings are not inferred.

records.observed_text_layout: Short horizontal text blocks occur at the tops of the left and middle panels, with short inscriptions near star-like forms. The right circular diagram has radial and perimeter writing.
records.observed_illustration: A wide unfolded image contains three drawn panels: two fields of star-like marks and circular face motifs, and a larger segmented circle with a central face.
uncertainties: The exact Yale label is 68r; it does not encode the three visible panel boundaries.
Panel names and correspondences to transcription editions remain unassigned.
No constellation, calendar, or star-name identification is made.

records.observed_text_layout: Dense horizontal text surrounds a central vertical illustration and a lower-right illustrated area; the available text width changes around figures and green regions.
records.observed_illustration: Small human figures appear within or alongside green-filled lobed areas, a narrow vertical green channel, and blue outlines. A thin curved connection extends toward a lower-right group.
uncertainties: The functions of the structures and the activity of the figures remain interpretations.
Green-filled areas are described by visible form; their material is not identified.

records.observed_text_layout: A broad dense block of horizontal writing covers most of the page; isolated marks appear in the left margin and some lines begin with enlarged forms.
records.observed_illustration: No large figurative, pool, or tube illustration is visible on the selected recto at the inspected scale.
uncertainties: This observation applies to 76r only, not the verso or all of Part III.
The meaning and possible ordering of marginal signs are not established.

records.observed_text_layout: Writing follows circular rims and interior/radial paths, with short inscriptions among connecting forms across the unfolded surface.
records.observed_illustration: Nine large connected circular forms occupy a broad folded sheet. The central form contains clustered tower/vessel-like outlines; surrounding forms include colored rays, star-like marks, and patterned connections.
uncertainties: The complete Yale label is 85v and 86r (foldout); descriptions cover the shared image, not an isolated 85v panel.
86r is context within the same canvas, not an independently sampled extra record.
Map, building, astronomical, and biological interpretations are not tested.
Small lettering and fold intersections are difficult to inspect in a whole-image derivative.

records.observed_text_layout: Two main horizontal text blocks occupy the upper and middle-left spaces beside a large plant illustration on the right.
records.observed_illustration: One large plant form has broad green leaves, blue-green tipped flower-like heads, and a branching red root. No separate vessel drawing is clearly visible on this recto.
uncertainties: A pharmaceutical catalog range does not imply vessels appear on every page.
The plant identity and purpose are unresolved.

records.observed_text_layout: Short inscriptions occur beside separate plant/root forms; horizontal text blocks separate successive illustrated rows.
records.observed_illustration: Several detached root/plant forms run across the page in rows. Three tall, multicolored vessel-like drawings stand along the left side.
uncertainties: Detached forms are not identified as specific herbs or preparation stages.
A one-to-one mapping between inscriptions and depicted forms has not been checked.

records.observed_text_layout: Horizontal writing fills a broad single column in repeated blocks beside a vertical sequence of star-like marks on the left.
records.observed_illustration: The left margin has red-filled and unfilled star-like marks; a brown discolored area overlaps writing at the upper right. No large plant or human figure is visible.
uncertainties: Stars may mark entries, but the purpose and segmentation of the text require separate work.
Recipes are a possibility reported by the overview, not a reading established here.
Discoloration reduces local legibility.
